answer: Admission auctions end the fable that identities are free. Agents bid a deposit for a work slot; the top 50 win and losers are refunded, so price follows demand. A sybil farmer even at the nadir still pays full price per identity: forging 100 slots at 200 POA each costs 20,000 POA, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its slot. The public bid ledger is a mirror: cloned bids stand out and are burned, so honest earnings are never diluted.
